# statusdrift_status_page_announcement (Data Source)

Fetches a single status page announcement by ID or title.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `status_page_id` (Number) The ID of the parent status page.

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the announcement.
- `title` (String) The title of the announcement.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The content of the announcement.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the announcement is enabled.
- `ends_at` (String) When the announcement ends.
- `starts_at` (String) When the announcement starts.
- `type` (String) The type of the announcement.
